idea-plugin.name: PHP Composer Script Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter icon per "scripts" entry of an open composer.json, showing whether it's used or an orphan candidate. A script counts as used when another script reuses it (@name, as Composer documents), or when a real invocation -- composer run-script <name>, composer run <name>, composer <name>, with options, composer.phar or @composer -- appears in:

  • CI configs: GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Travis CI, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines;
  • build and container files: Makefile, package.json, Dockerfile, compose files, shell scripts in the project root, bin/, scripts/ and build/;
  • git hooks: CaptainHook, GrumPHP;
  • docs: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md (and the other instructions files for coding agents), Markdown files in docs/, and READMEs one folder down.

A script's scripts-aliases (Composer 2.7+) count as the script, and a CI matrix picked by composer ${{ matrix.task }} is recognized.

Recognizes Composer's own documented script event names (pre-install-cmd, post-autoload-dump, etc.) as always-used, same as npm lifecycle scripts.

100% static text analysis, no Composer CLI invocation. Not read: files outside those paths, PHP code that runs Composer itself, and commands only ever typed by hand -- a script used only that way shows as an orphan candidate, which is exactly what the icon says: nothing in the project calls it.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
